features.name: page_value_log_normalized
features.description: Log-transformed PageValues normalized by training mean, capturing purchase intent signal on a smooth scale suitable for linear margins
features.expected_model_benefit: PageValues is highly predictive; log transform reduces skew and normalization centers the feature for SVM margin optimization

features.name: exit_bounce_composite
features.description: Weighted sum of ExitRates and BounceRates normalized to [0,1], representing overall session disengagement severity
features.expected_model_benefit: Combined exit and bounce signal provides a smooth continuous disengagement score useful for linear separation

features.name: bounce_exit_ratio
features.description: Ratio of BounceRates to ExitRates indicating how much of exit behavior is pure bounces versus engaged exits
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures relative bounce severity; high ratio suggests low-quality traffic, useful for linear decision boundary

features.name: product_engagement_score
features.description: Log-transformed product-related duration scaled by number of product pages visited, measuring depth of product exploration
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures intensity of product browsing behavior; continuous score works well with SVM linear kernel

features.name: special_day_proximity_penalty
features.description: SpecialDay value as a penalty score; higher values indicate proximity to special days which may reduce purchase conversion
features.expected_model_benefit: Special day proximity is a smooth continuous feature that linearly penalizes conversion likelihood

features.name: returning_visitor_flag
features.description: Binary indicator for returning visitors who have higher baseline purchase intent than new visitors
features.expected_model_benefit: Returning visitors have different conversion patterns; binary feature provides clean linear split

features.name: high_value_month_score
features.description: Numeric score encoding months with historically higher shopping activity (Nov, Dec get higher scores, Feb/Jun lower)
features.expected_model_benefit: Encodes seasonal purchase intent as a continuous score for linear model to exploit temporal patterns
features.formula: np.where(Month == 'Nov', 1.0, np.where(Month == 'Dec', 0.9, np.where(Month == 'Oct', 0.7, np.where(Month == 'Sep', 0.6, np.where(Month == 'Aug', 0.5, np.where(Month == 'Jul', 0.5, np.where(Month == 'May', 0.4, np.where(Month == 'Mar', 0.3, np.where(Month == 'June', 0.2, 0.1)))))))))

features.name: administrative_engagement_log
features.description: Log-transformed administrative duration indicating time spent on account/admin pages as a session depth signal
features.expected_model_benefit: Administrative engagement correlates with purchase intent; log scale reduces skew for linear models

features.name: informational_depth_score
features.description: Combined informational engagement score from page count and duration, normalized to capture research behavior intensity
features.expected_model_benefit: Research behavior before purchase is a smooth continuous signal useful for linear margin separation

features.name: weekend_session_indicator
features.description: Binary weekend flag indicating sessions occurring on weekends which may have different purchase conversion patterns
features.expected_model_benefit: Weekend vs weekday sessions have different behavioral patterns; clean binary feature for linear models

features.name: session_quality_composite
features.description: Holistic assessment of session quality combining page value signal strength, low bounce/exit rates, and meaningful product engagement into a single composite score from 0 (poor quality) to 1 (high quality)
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a single interpretable quality score that captures multiple engagement dimensions, useful as a strong linear feature for SVM

features.name: traffic_source_quality_score
features.description: Semantic quality score for traffic source based on TrafficType category, where direct/organic traffic (types 1,2,3) scores higher (0.7-1.0) than paid/referral traffic (0.3-0.6) and unknown sources score lowest (0.1-0.3)
features.expected_model_benefit: Traffic source quality is a meaningful continuous proxy for visitor intent that provides smooth linear signal for SVM margins
